work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory logs, checked incoming deliveries against purchase records, and flagged discrepancies for review by purchasing staff.
Prepared order paperwork, coordinated dispatch schedules with warehouse staff, and tracked outstanding requests through routine follow-up with suppliers.

projects.title: Handcrafted Feature Baselines for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented a histogram of oriented gradients baseline with a linear support vector classifier for categorizing images using fixed training and validation splits.
Compared classification errors across feature normalization settings and inspected confusion matrices to identify categories affected by similar shapes and backgrounds.
